items.title: Reject false chess claims on actual development positions
items.instructions: Read research/chess-extended-claims-2026-09-22.md and the no-forward capability gate first. scripts/chess_extended_claims.py now implements strict source-bound square occupation and explicit variation-legality checks; 41 new tests and the 29 existing adapter tests pass, and the full project suite passed 1325 tests with one disclosed host-permission skip. Do not recreate this module or treat unchanged test runs as new implementation. The original broader factuality item remains open: implement a separately versioned development-only experiment for these extended claims. Freeze its input manifest and expected outcomes BEFORE measuring, include valid occupations/variations and deliberate false/foreign-reference/misattributed-PV/unsupported-claim controls, preserve every requested outcome including failures, and retain provenance, exact hashes and a separate verification replay. Reuse the new public validate_extended_claim API and the retained real development projection; do not modify historical adapters or receipts. This is evaluator-only work: a full typed packet, post-move FEN, PV, solution/theme, annotation or future-derived feature must never enter a commentary generator. Add both the actual experiment source and meaningful tests in one grounded proposal; use expectedSha256:null and oldText:"" for a new absent file, with checks that run the new tests. The native executor implements accepted edits and retains logs. No new model/engine calls or heldout scoring are needed. Preserve all original tasks, jobs, budgets, data and native ownership. Independent acceptance of the broader result remains separate.

items.title: Measure the configured local explanation model against real-board baselines
items.instructions: Current authority is the chess-only no-forward gate in research/chess-commentary-capability-gate-v1.md. The legacy prototype/chess_concept_model.py exposes evaluator-only engine continuations and must not be used for a no-forward generation or capability claim. Before any generation, implement and test a separately versioned strict allowlist input boundary that rejects engine PV tails, post-move FENs, future moves/features, solution/theme or answer labels, annotations and evaluator-only material. The allowed fields and assertion types are exactly those in the gate; do not add an assisted condition to bypass it. Reuse verified development provenance and legal transition checks. Freeze at most eight permitted development generation inputs, exact local model identity/settings and schema before calls. Preserve raw output, abstentions and all failed/not-run cases; score factuality, reference validity, uncertainty, latency and failures separately. Use only the registered local route and native executor; preserve 131072 context and existing reasoning settings. A deterministic board-fact comparator and any continuation-based evaluator stay outside the generator input. The current eight historical test puzzles are not blind evaluation evidence: do not tune or score them. A new game-disjoint heldout protocol and later independent qualified evaluation are required before capability claims. Missing boundary code is implementation work, not an external blocker. Submit concrete source edits and real tests; do not rerun baseline checks as progress. Preserve existing task/job/budget history and sibling file ownership. No cloud activation, spending, external contact, release or board-game expansion.

items.title: Show real boards, alternatives and claim evidence in a useful local interface
items.instructions: Current user authority is continuous chess-first local research and implementation using real permitted data. Read the current program and actual source before dispatch. Ordinary local dependency setup and bounded public open-data acquisition are authorized; the historical GPL/local dependency HOLD is superseded. Preserve existing job identity and disjoint file ownership. Use the existing project executor and discovered local tool/model configuration; do not create a scheduler, replay a job, change hosted routing, spend, publish, contact people or ingest unlicensed creator content. No chess result establishes sports competence. Record actual commands, hashes, complete failures and acceptance evidence. After this packet, add a distinct useful successor; this long-term project stays active. Build or adapt an independently owned local view of the real Lichess development evidence, reusing the generated board report. Show source game, pre/post board, selected move, engine alternatives, checkable claims, uncertainty and actual limitations in plain language. Label deterministic templates and raw PVs explicitly; do not present engine text as a trained explanation. Coordinate before changing the sibling-owned existing demo. Avoid duplicate listeners: use a static artifact or a finite preview with shutdown, or the existing service owner. Verify legal board orientation, source/evidence links, failed-case rendering and honest sample counts. Retain screenshots/inspection receipts when browser access exists. The next packet should close a concrete usability or evidence gap found by inspection.

items.title: Build and test a no-forward Stockfish chess-commentary candidate
items.instructions: Read research/chess-commentary-capability-gate-v1.md first. The current chess_concept_model prompt exposes retained engine PVs, so it cannot meet the requested commentator constraint. Implement a separately versioned no-forward commentator packet and evaluator without changing historic receipt formats or sibling-owned legacy model files unless ownership is coordinated. The generator may see only the pre-move FEN, selected move, deterministic transition facts, typed engine observation and declared concept vocabulary; it must never receive pv_uci, a post-move FEN, solution/theme, reply sequence, human annotation or continuation-derived feature. Add fail-first tests for every forbidden field, provenance/hash binding, legal board claims, engine-reference attribution, strategic-claim uncertainty and abstention. Freeze a new game-disjoint heldout protocol before any quality result; do not use the historical eight test items as blind evidence. Run local implementation/tests through the native executor, retain raw packets and complete failures, and send the exact result to independent acceptance. Do not call the result professional-level or expand to other board games unless every condition in the gate document, including independent qualified review, is actually satisfied. A passing structural test is only a candidate capability, not a commentary-quality result.
